extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the exact BZT52C3V0S row was selected from the BZT52C2V0S through BZT52C75S electrical-characteristics table for manufacturer hongjiacheng.
The supplied PDF identity was verified as LCSC C19077436, MPN BZT52C3V0S, manufacturer hongjiacheng, with SHA-256 8d99c0b95ddbd62581320fd03378a72d97d914bc201c735536cd50e5f6753113.

The BZT52C3V0S row gives VZ minimum 2.8 V, nominal 3.0 V, and maximum 3.2 V at IZT = 5 mA; maximum ZZT = 95 ohm at IZT, maximum ZZK = 600 ohm at IZK = 1 mA, maximum reverse leakage IR = 10 microA at VR = 1.0 V, and admissible IZM = 5 mA, with TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.

The p. 3 zener-characteristic plot is a shared series-level graph whose visible low-voltage traces are not individually labeled for BZT52C3V0S, so no target-specific curve points were assigned. The p. 3 capacitance and dynamic-impedance plots are also family-level typical characteristics without a uniquely identified BZT52C3V0S trace or tabulated capacitance value.

No component-specific reverse-recovery time is published in the supplied datasheet. Maximum ratings include PD = 200 mW and forward voltage VF = 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA on p. 1; junction and storage temperature limits are -55 to +150 degC and typical RthetaJ-A is 417 degC/W.
extraction.omission_reason: No target-specific usable curve was extracted: the datasheet plots are shared series-level characteristics, and the BZT52C3V0S trace is not individually identified with unambiguous numeric points. Capacitance is shown only in a shared typical series plot without a target-specific tabulated value, and reverse recovery time is not published.
